digest.component_or_area: integration test harness for binding lifecycle reconciliation
propositions: Integration-tier mutation oracle is missing for the out-of-window binding lifecycle absence cluster (clear_absent, note_absent, note_absent_or_rekey), pinned only at unit tier with no reach guard in real reconciliation flow.

The clear_absent call sites in binding_walk.py and outbound_mutation_builders.py gate on out-of-window-but-alive keys, but the idempotency test fixture seeds all keys in-window, making the code unreachable and preventing mutation detection.

The bound-but-absent direct GET runs through a real backend whose transport 404s for synthetic keys, bypassing the fake harness transport — requiring backend wiring in the test to exercise the 02c4 RCA path.

An integration test must verify that an out-of-window-but-alive key reaches clear_absent with zero mutations, zero Jira writes, unchanged updated_at, and stable bindings.json bytes across repeated passes — detecting if clear_absent unconditionally stamps updated_at.

A second integration test must verify the 404→alive round-trip: note_absent records absence with the lifecycle clock sentinel, then clear_absent resets the counter — exercising the moved cluster's siblings at integration tier.
